ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution comprising approximately 94% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to approximately 6% concentrated at the distal tips and scattered micro-mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white contiguous blobs localized at the extreme lateral tips of both left and right lobes. A sparse distribution of small, high-intensity white speckles is present across the central and basal regions of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, deep U-shaped notch with a pixel-measured interior angle of approximately 28 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations visible on the distal third of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge appears more linear with minimal pixel-level variation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to tapered, elongated tips; the overall geometry follows a moderately swept-back profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of roughly circular white pixel groups (5-10 pixel diameter) concentrated in the lower central region near the peduncle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct diagonal light-intensity linear mark (approx. 40 pixels in length) observed on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable high-intensity scarring/pigmentation at the extreme lateral tips; possible minor indentation at the terminal edge of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'white-tipped' appearance is highly distinctive, where the high-intensity pixels form a ragged, high-contrast boundary at the furthest lateral points of the flukes.
